rows.failed_obligation: A total count of large-prime exponents does not imply prime-by-prime divisibility containment.
rows.minimal_repair_direction: Use only consequences of the total-exponent inequality, or establish any needed prime-specific statement separately.
rows.reason: For distinct primes \(p,q>10^{100}\), \(X=pq\) and \(Y=p^2\) have \(\mho(X)=\mho(Y)=2\), but \(q\mid X\) and \(q\nmid Y\). Earlier nodes are valid definitions or restatements.

rows.reason: Nodes n13--n16 correctly describe an individual composition and its top-degree coefficient. But cancellation can leave degree not divisible by \(d\): for \(f(t)=t^3\), \(f(x)+f(-x+1)=3x^2-3x+1\), of degree 2. Thus n17, and consequently n18, do not follow; n13 is not itself erroneous.
